commits.message:
Close the saved agent-policy popup without waiting for its unload acknowledgment

The Settings handoff journey saved policy successfully but stalled in Playwright's default Page.close call. Use its runBeforeUnload close mode and return to the original handoff tab; every policy, key, command, packet and custody assertion remains unchanged.

commits.message:
Wait for event selection before checking offline destination custody

The recovery journey can read the issue URL before React commits its selected event and occurrence parameters. Wait for that actual browser destination before retaining it, then preserve the existing exact destination, focus, draft and no-write assertions.

Revoke only the deploy key created by the Settings journey

Select the minted credential by its returned hash rather than unordered row position. Assert that existing keys remain active so the later built-in capture keeps its original ingest authority. Preserve all capture, navigation and archive assertions.
